mechanism.claim: A close beyond the complete high-low envelope of the prior thirty eight-hour BTC auctions is accepted multi-day price discovery rather than a five-minute channel touch. When the breakout auction is also in a causally high realized-variation state, follow the close-confirmed direction for twenty-four elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: long above the frozen prior-thirty-block high; short below the frozen prior-thirty-block low
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSDBR uses a close-confirmed roughly ten-day channel built from exact non-overlapping eight-hour auctions and a fixed twenty-four-hour relay. The rejected raw Donchian scan used five-minute rolling channels with path-dependent ATR exits; HVDCR required a breakout, defended pullback, and later reclaim; record breadth counts sequential extrema. No prior event set, control, fitted outcome, flow, funding, OI, premium, or cross-asset input is reused.
mechanism.prior_art_boundary: the repository rejects raw five-minute Donchian-plus-ATR grids but explicitly permits a materially slower execution horizon
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the breakout auction's strict-prior realized-variation rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 02:05/10:05/18:05 UTC close-confirmed multi-day breakout onsets with twenty-four-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute bars [D-8h,D), aggregated first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close
features.channel: maximum block high and minimum block low over the thirty immediately preceding exact source-valid eight-hour blocks; current block excluded; any missing block invalidates the decision
features.breakout: current block close strictly above channel high or strictly below channel low; equality and dual conflict are ineligible
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute close/open log returns inside the current block), strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible: strict close breakout and variation gate
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent slow close-confirmed channel breakout mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no channel length, close confirmation, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
